title: Restriction of morphisms from the image-open free sheaf
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes, $j:Y\to X$ an open immersion [def-sc-zariski-site], and $F$ any abelian sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Write $L_W$ for the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf on the representable of the open $W$ [lem-pc-free-mayer-vietoris-short-exact]. For $W=j(Y)$, the map $\operatorname{Hom}_X(L_W,F)\to\operatorname{Hom}_Y(j^{-1}L_W,j^{-1}F)$ sending $a$ to $j^{-1}a$ [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] is bijective.

source.place: Stacks Tags 03DI (extension-by-zero adjunction), 03DJ (exactness), and 04J0 (localization of morphisms of ringed sites); represented free-sheaf restriction and inverse image in the open-subscheme Zariski case.

proof.text: The sheafification, free/forgetful and Yoneda adjunctions give a natural equivalence Hom(L_W,F) ≃ F(W). Construct naive open restriction R and direct image G. The image/preimage adjunction on opens, opposed and whiskered by abelian groups, restricts along the fully faithful inclusions of sheaves to an adjunction R ⊣ G. These are Mathlib IsOpenMap.adjunction, Adjunction.op, Adjunction.whiskerLeft and Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful.

For W = j.opensRange, the unit on F evaluated at W is F applied to the opposite of the image/preimage counit j(j⁻¹W) → W. Mathlib Opens.functor_obj_map_obj identifies its source with image(j) ∩ W = W; thus this inclusion is an isomorphism. Hence the unit on sections at W is bijective. By naturality of the represented free-sheaf/sections equivalence, postcomposition with the sheaf unit is bijective on Hom(L_W,F).

The unit naturality identity identifies postcomposition with the unit with R.map followed by the adjunction Hom equivalence. Since both the composite and that equivalence are bijective, R.map is bijective. Transport through Mathlib IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullbackIso by conjugating with its component isomorphisms; naturality identifies the transported map with (invImage j).map. The same image/preimage identity works for empty and top opens.

proof_origin.place: Direct represented-sections proof of the open-restriction assertion; formalized using Mathlib Topology/Category/TopCat/Opens.lean (IsOpenMap.adjunction and Opens.functor_obj_map_obj), CategoryTheory/Adjunction/{Opposites,Whiskering,Restrict}.lean, and Topology/Sheaves/Functors.lean (IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullbackIso). No extension-by-zero theorem is required.

theorem H.openFreeSheaf_restrictionHom_bijective {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]

      (invImage j).map a)
